items.name: The Ferrero Fantasy
items.description: Once upon a time, chocolate met its perfect match — hazelnut. Rich chocolate cake, silky chocolate frosting, luscious ganache dripping down every side, and delicate chocolate swirls came together to create a little slice of heaven. Every bite is a dreamy blend of deep cocoa and creamy sweetness, made for celebrations, special moments, or simply when an ordinary day deserves something extraordinary.

items.name: Golden Confetti Vanilla Cupcake
items.description: Pure celebration baked into every single swirl. Crafted with churned creamery butter and fragrant Madagascar vanilla beans, this tender golden sponge delivers the nostalgic, sunny warmth of an authentic scratch-baked cupcake. Swirled with a light, silky vanilla buttercream and showered with pastel confetti drops and golden sprinkles, it brings playful charm and sweet joy to any party platter.

items.name: Red Velvet Blossom Cupcake
items.description: A classic favourite made with timeless bakery elegance. Featuring our signature cultured buttermilk sponge infused with a delicate whisper of cocoa, it bakes into a soft, velvety crimson crumb. Hand-piped with a generous rosette of smooth vanilla cream cheese frosting and dusted with handcrafted red velvet cake crumbs, it delivers the quintessential harmony of sweet, tangy, and melt-in-the-mouth comfort.
ingredients: handcrafted red velvet cake crumb garnish.

items.name: The Eton Mess Berry Bliss
items.description:
A beautiful little mess that tastes like a dream.
Once upon a time, sweet strawberries and tangy raspberries tumbled into clouds of whipped cream, bringing along delicate, crunchy pieces of meringue. What began as a playful mess became a wonderfully indulgent cake — bursting with berry sweetness, creamy layers and delightful crunch in every bite. Sometimes, the sweetest things are the ones that don't need to be perfect.

items.name: The Queen’s Cake
items.description:
A cake that turned ordinary moments into royal celebrations. Two golden layers held a secret of sweet strawberry jam and clouds of creamy goodness. Fresh strawberries crowned the top like jewels, while delicate almonds added the final touch of magic.
They called it The Queen’s Cake — not because it belonged to a queen, but because everyone who tasted it deserved to feel like royalty.

items.name: The Chocolate Drama Queen
items.description: Meet the cake that refuses to do things by halves. Two layers of rich chocolate sponge, generous swirls of cream, rivers of chocolate sauce, and a crown of brownie crumbles and chocolate chunks. It's messy, magnificent, unapologetically indulgent — and absolutely worth every crumb. Because ordinary days deserve extraordinary cake.

items.name: The Once-Upon-a-Strawberry Ice-cream
items.description: Every slice feels like a little escape into a sweeter world. Creamy strawberry ice cream meets a bright kiss of lemon, crowned with fresh strawberries, fluffy frosting and colourful sprinkles. A dreamy frozen creation where berry sweetness and citrus sparkle live happily ever after.

items.name: The Chocoholic Dream Layer Cake
items.description: For the love of chocolate, this dream was made! Two layers of rich, moist chocolate sponge embrace a smooth, creamy vanilla filling, all crowned with a glossy chocolate topping. Finished with an irresistible mountain of chocolate bars, truffles, wafers and sweet little chocolate bites, every slice is a delicious adventure. One bite is never quite enough!

items.name: Chocolate Strawberry Forest Cake
items.description: A playful summer reinterpretation of the Black Forest gateau, crafted for pure celebration. Layers of tender dark chocolate sponge are steeped in delicate strawberry nectar, then enveloped in freshly whipped Chantilly cream. Between each tier, slow-simmered strawberry compote meets juicy, orchard-fresh berries, crowned with dark cocoa sponge crumbles and glistening fruit. It balances the bittersweet depth of cocoa with the bright tang of ripe strawberries—earthy, airy, and textured in every bite.

items.name: The Gourmet Party Platter
items.description: Make every gathering special with our Gourmet Party Platter, featuring a colourful assortment of cheese cubes, seasoned cheese bites, olives, and tangy antipasti. Perfect for parties, birthdays, office celebrations, family gatherings, and entertaining guests.

items.name: The Carnivore's Craving
items.description: For those who believe every great feast deserves a little extra indulgence! Dive into a delicious spread of savoury cured meats, rich cheeses, and flavour-packed bites, thoughtfully arranged for sharing. Perfect for celebrations, get-togethers, or simply treating yourself to something special.

items.name: The Main Character Darling
items.description: Cancel the plans, light your favourite candle, and let the evening be all about you. The Main Character Darling is your little box of happiness, filled with juicy strawberries, sweet grapes, crunchy crackers, creamy cheese, savoury bites, and a touch of chocolate indulgence. No special occasion needed — being you is reason enough to celebrate!
ingredients: Assorted cheese slices or cheese rolls

items.name: Golden Hearth Cheddar Scones
items.description: Nothing says honest British baking quite like the comforting aroma of cheese bubbling in a hot oven. Our Golden Hearth Cheddar Scones are crafted with extra-mature British farmhouse cheddar folded throughout cold-cut butter dough, flecked with fresh herbs and a hint of English mustard for depth. Baked until tall, tender, and crowned with a crisp, caramelised lace of melted cheese, every bite reveals a flaky, buttery crumb. Warm them through, split them open, and slather with salted farmhouse butter for an unforgettable morning tea or savoury afternoon treat.

items.name: Orchard Crumble Tart & Petite Berry Galettes
items.description: Inspired by time-honoured country baking, this centerpiece features a crisp, shortcrust pastry base layered with slow-simmered spiced orchard fruit compote. Blanket-topped with golden, buttery almond streusel crumble and a light snowfall of confectioner’s sugar, it is finished with fresh ruby strawberries. Encircling the main tart are our fluted petal tarts, each holding a warm fruit center crowned with whole garden berries for individual indulgence.

items.name: Orchard Crest Banana Loaflets
items.description: We believe honest banana bread should be dense, rich, and deeply fragrant. Baked from over-ripened, caramelized bananas blended with pure creamery butter, dark brown sugar, and warm bakery spices, each individual loaf achieves that coveted golden-crusted edge and melt-in-the-mouth, moist center. Instead of a simple slice, we elevate each mini loaf with a swirl of whipped vanilla cream cheese frosting, hand-topped with ripe English strawberries, plump blueberries, tangy kiwi, raspberries, and fresh banana rounds. A nostalgic favourite turned into an artisan teatime centrepiece.

items.name: Citrus Berry Chocolate Cupcake
items.description: Rich patisserie tradition meets bright orchard vibrancy. Built on an intensely dark, fudgy cocoa sponge, this cupcake is mounded with billowy whipped cream and finely shaved dark chocolate. Crowned with a ripe English strawberry, a whole stem cherry, a zesty wedge of lemon, and a warm Belgian dark chocolate drizzle, each bite balances deep cocoa indulgence with a lively, fruit-forward finish.

items.name: Ivory Swirl White Chocolate Muffins
items.description: The ultimate balance of rich cocoa depth and smooth, buttery sweetness. We gently swirl creamy European white chocolate into a tender cocoa sponge, allowing pockets of caramelized white chocolate to melt through the crumb as it bakes. Silky, golden, and gently balanced, it delivers all the warmth of a classic bake with a delicate, milky finish.
ingredients: premium Belgian white chocolate chips/chunks (pure cocoa butter

items.name: Sea Salt Dark Chocolate Puddle Cookie
items.description: Some things are simply better unhurried. Made with browned English butter and slow-rested dough, this cookie bakes to a golden, craggy edge while leaving the center sumptuously chewy and soft. Hand-chopped shards of 70% dark Belgian chocolate melt into molten pockets throughout, finished with a deliberate pinch of flaky Maldon sea salt to balance the rich cocoa depth. It is the classic bakery comfort cookie, elevated.

items.name: The Cocoa Duo: Midnight Trio & Silk Velvet Cookies
items.description: A study in contrasting chocolates, tailored for those who believe choosing just one is impossible. The Midnight Trio packs a dense, fudgy dark cocoa base loaded with molten dark chunks, creamy milk drops, and smooth white chocolate gems. Alongside it sits the Silk Velvet, a golden brown-sugar crumb studded with caramelized milk chocolate morsels that melt into pure, nostalgic warmth. Freshly baked, generously textured, and best enjoyed side-by-side.

items.name: Salted Caramel Snow Snickerdoodles
items.description: Soft, pillowy, and gently spiced, these tender bakery rounds melt the moment they touch your tongue. Rolled in a delicate dusting of confectioner's snow before baking, each cookie develops a subtle crackled crust around a melt-in-the-mouth, buttery core. A drizzle of slow-simmered, golden sea-salt caramel across the top delivers a sweet, buttery crunch that pairs with morning lattes or an afternoon pot of tea

items.name: Red Velvet Molten Fudge Drops
items.description: Bold in colour and rich in flavour, these crimson jewels bring all the magic of red velvet into a warm cookie shape. Crafted with buttermilk and a delicate kiss of cocoa, the outer crumb is soft and chewy, while the heart of every cookie holds a sunken pool of rich, dark cocoa truffle fudge that stays luscious and gooey. A striking centrepiece for any dessert box.
ingredients: natural beetroot extract/food colour (for crimson hue)

items.name: The Confection Collection
items.description: "A Celebration in Every Swirl "Why choose one favourite when you can indulge in four? We created The Signature Quartet for those who believe great baking is about variety, texture, and pure comfort.   From the bright, sunny tang of hand-picked blueberries and zesty lemon curd to the deep cocoa decadence of peanut-butter chocolate drizzle, every cupcake in this box tells its own delicious story. Balanced with classic crimson velvet and our warmly spiced, pecan-topped carrot sponge, this box is baked fresh each morning using honest ingredients, creamy butter, and unhurried craft. Perfect for sharing, gifting, or finding your personal favourite.
ingredients: Lemon Blueberry Sunshine : Fluffy vanilla-citrus sponge studded with fresh blueberries topped with whipped buttercream frosting fresh wild blueberries and fragrant lemon zest
Classic Red Velvet: Traditional soft buttermilk cocoa crumb with a silky vanilla cream cheese frosting finished with delicate red velvet cake crumbles
Chocolate Fudge & Peanut Butter: Rich dark chocolate sponge crowned with creamy whipped peanut butter frosting finished with chocolate peanut butter cups and a glossy fudge drizzle
Spiced Carrot & Toasted Pecan: Spiced sponge packed with freshly grated carrots topped with rich spiced cream cheese frosting crunchy roasted pecans and a hand-crafted fondant carrot accent.

items.name: Obsidian Chocolate Muffins
items.description: Born from a love for pure, uncompromised cocoa, these muffins are crafted for the true chocolate devotee. Baked to a tender, bakery-style crumb and generously folded with pockets of molten dark chocolate, each bite melts into a rich, bittersweet finish reminiscent of an artisan chocolate truffle. Perfect alongside a hot espresso or warm morning flat white.

items.name: Artisan Marbled Fudge Brownies
items.description: A rich bake for true cocoa purists. Crafted with melted 70% dark Belgian chocolate and slow-churned butter, our brownie trays are baked until they develop that iconic paper-thin crinkled sheen while preserving an ultra-dense, molten fudge center. Swirled with dark ganache ribbons and studded with sunken chocolate chunks, these slab loaves slice into thick, decadent squares that melt smoothly on the palate.

items.name: Golden Butter Croissant
items.description: Simplicity honed to an art form. Crafted following an authentic three-day fermentation and lamination rhythm, slow-cultured European butter is folded inside delicate, yeasted dough to create dozens of gossamer-thin layers. Baked to an audible, shatteringly crisp bronzed shell with an airy, honeycombed center that melts on the tongue, it is the purest celebration of rich churned butter and honest patisserie technique.
ingredients: high-fat cultured European unsalted butter (for lamination)

items.name: Silk Blossom Almond Croissant
items.description: A Parisian bakery secret born of tradition and indulgence. Our signature all-butter croissant is split and bathed in fragrant Madagascar bourbon vanilla syrup, then filled generously with rich, stone-ground almond frangipane cream. Topped with more velvety almond cream and a generous blanket of toasted flaked Valencia almonds, it is returned to the hearth until golden-crusted and dusted with a fine snowfall of confectioner’s sugar.

items.name: The Sunny Noodle Combo
items.description: Opposites attract in the sweetest way possible. The Sunny Noodle Combo brings together the bright, sun-kissed swirls of our caramel-blonde white chocolate muffins with the deep, fudgy indulgence of pure dark cocoa. Named for its golden morning warmth and playfully tangled artisan marble patterns, this duo is baked fresh for moments that call for a little bit of sunshine and a lot of honest chocolate comfort. Whether it’s breakfast on the run or an afternoon coffee companion, it’s the ultimate two-tone treat.
ingredients: premium Belgian white chocolate chips/chunks (pure cocoa butter

items.name: Artisan Meringue Pavlova Nests
items.description: Light as air and crisp to the bite, each hand-piped meringue nest is slow-baked to achieve a delicate outer shell with a soft, marshmallow-like interior. Nestled inside is a cloud of freshly whipped vanilla bean chantilly cream, heaped with garden raspberries, wild blueberries, sliced English strawberries, and bright, tangy kiwi. Finished with a glistening fruit glaze, it offers an airy, refreshing balance of sweet crunch and ripe citrus fruit.

items.name: Strawberries & Cream Parfait Glass
items.description: A celebration of warm British summers served in crystal glass. Built layer by layer, this dessert features soft butter sponge soaked in vanilla syrup, layered with a velvety fold of clotted cream custard and heaps of freshly diced sweet English strawberries. Topped with a mountain of whipped cream and our crunchy roasted almond-granola streusel, every spoonful balances smooth creaminess with satisfying crunch.

items.name: It's Jamain-Man, Cherry Pie!
items.description: Rustic comfort straight from the baker’s oven. Cradled in a flaky, all-butter crimped pastry crust, this pie is filled with plump tart cherries gently cooked down in their natural ruby juices with cinnamon and lemon peel. Completely cloaked under a thick blanket of golden-toasted brown butter oat crumble, it bakes until bubbling and fragrant. Warm, hearty, and best shared by the slice with a generous pour of hot custard or clotted cream.

items.name: The Grand Bakery Sampler Platter
items.description: Curated for intimate gatherings, teatime treats, and effortless gifting. The Grand Bakery Sampler brings together our finest kitchen creations on a single silver platter: a chilled berry-and-cream fruit trifle bowl, artisan piped cupcakes, a chewy golden cookie, rich cocoa sponge, and our signature crinkle-top dark fudge brownie. Accented with hand-selected British strawberries and orchard cherries, it offers a vibrant tasting tour of everything TeeCake Creations bakes best.

items.name: Cherry Blossom Swirl Cream
items.description: Inspired by the fleeting beauty of cherry blossom season, our Cherry Blossom Swirl Cream brings a touch of delicate elegance to your table. We start with fresh double cream whipped to light, cloud-like peaks, infused with fragrant Madagascar vanilla. Through this velvety base, we hand-fold slow-simmered, ruby-red cherry compote, creating ribbons that bloom across the cream like cherry blossoms caught in a gentle breeze. Tangy, sweet, and featherlight, it turns any dessert, warm pastry, or quiet moment into a sweet celebration.

items.name: The Ultimate Dessert Party Platter
items.description: The undisputed showstopper for celebrations, birthdays, and weekend parties. Stacked high with decadence, this generous spread features a generous mountain of thick, molten-core dark fudge brownie slabs alongside buttery, chewy chocolate chip cookies. Surrounded by a vibrant fleet of artisan cupcakes—including rainbow confetti vanilla bakes, mocha drizzle swirls, chocolate crunch rosettes, and fresh cherry-crowned gateaux—there is an indulgent favourite here for every guest at the table.

items.name: Bake-at-Home Gourmet Cookie Dough Combo
items.description: Experience the magic of the bakery fresh from your own hearth. Our ready-to-bake dough trays are slow-mixed with browned English butter, rich brown sugars, and cold-rested for 24 hours to develop profound toffee notes. One tray comes laden with hand-cut Belgian dark chocolate chunks, while the other features velvety, melt-in-the-mouth white chocolate buttons. Simply scoop, bake until the edges turn golden and crisp, and enjoy gooey, molten cookies straight from your oven in minutes.

items.name: The Festive Jubilee Celebration Set
items.description: Designed to take center stage at festive holiday tables and joyful family gatherings. The crown jewel is a golden confetti sponge layered with vanilla bean frosting, adorned with a garland of hand-piped cream rosettes, vibrant whole English strawberries, sunlit lemon crescent twists, and pastel sugar sprinkles. Circling the centerpiece gateau is an assortment of party-ready cupcakes topped with chocolate drizzle candy bars, dark chocolate cream biscuits, and jewel-toned rainbow drops. A vibrant spread that brings festive cheer to every celebration.

items.name: Frosty Hearth Snowman Nests
items.description: A whimsical winter-wonderland treat crafted to delight guests of all ages. Resting inside chocolate fluted cases, these cups feature a crunchy base of toasted puffed rice tossed in rich melted milk chocolate and golden syrup. Perched atop each nest is a handcrafted dual-tier marshmallow snowman—finished in snowy white chocolate and blush pink strawberry glaze—each with chocolate-piped smiling faces and button details. Presented under a crystal cloche, it captures the playful magic of the festive season.
ingredients: natural strawberry extract glaze (for blush pink snowmen)
dark cocoa piping glaze (for eyes and buttons)

items.name: Somerset Cherry Royale Feast
items.description:
The Ultimate Warm & Cold Indulgence
Designed to be paired together straight from the table. Serve a hot, steaming slice of the golden brown-butter streusel pie—with its bubbling ruby fruit center—side-by-side with a generous, chilled cloud of the velvety cherry-swirled double cream. As the cool, marbled cream melts against the hot oat-and-almond crumble, it creates an unforgettable harmony of crisp pastry and silky richness.

items.name: Golden Honeycomb Croissant
items.description: A masterclass in artisanal viennoiserie, named for the intricate, airy honeycomb structure revealed with every tender tear. Crafted with stoneground French flour and high-fat cultured churned butter, the dough undergoes a slow, multi-day cold fermentation and meticulous folding process. Baked in the hearth until deeply bronzed and shatteringly crisp on the outside, each crescent is dusted warm from the oven with a whisper of fine snowfall sugar. It offers an irresistible balance of gossamer-thin buttery flakes, delicate caramelized warmth, and a cloud-soft interior.

items.name: Chocolate, Fruit & Nut Cake
items.description: A delightful handcrafted creation made with premium artisanal ingredients.
